relevant_laws.quote: shall not follow any fire apparatus traveling in response to a fire alarm closer than 500 feet or driving to or park such vehicle within 500 feet of fire apparatus which stopped in answer to a fire alarm
relevant_laws.notes: The grounded hill-crest follow cell names a fire apparatus. Traveling alarm response, stopped answer to alarm, and the subject's emergency authorization and official business remain separate source premises. Relevance does not establish either premise or a measured gap.
